Make sure to obey coding standards and best practices when implementing features or fixing bugs. This includes writing clean, maintainable code, following the project's style guidelines, following separation of concerns, and ensuring that your code is well-documented. Always test your changes thoroughly to ensure they work as intended and do not introduce new issues.

Consider that this game might get played with a data base of over 100,000 songs, so performance and scalability should be taken into account when implementing features or fixing bugs. Optimize your code for efficiency and consider the impact of your changes on the overall performance of the application.

Please follow the architecture of frontend/backend.

Test changes by opening the game yourself (frontend + backend) and playing it to ensure that everything works as expected. Pay attention to any errors or issues that may arise during gameplay and address them accordingly.
